{"id":1995871299,"question_id":4171,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1777990766,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1995871299/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Rotate Non Negative Elements","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> rotateElements(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        vector<int>positives;\n        for(auto it : nums) if(it >= 0) positives.push_back(it);\n\n        int m = positives.size();\n        k %= m;\n        rotate(positives.begin() , positives.begin() + k , positives.end());\n\n        int index = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) if(nums[i] >= 0) nums[i] = positives[index++];\n        \n        return nums;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"rotate-non-negative-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1976}
